about: Hand validation of the support rule (eval/metrics.ts). grounded = the story states, or translates to, everything the sentence claims; boilerplate, template text and added advice are not grounded. Round 1 used the rule as specified; precision was under 80%, so the rule was revised once and re-validated on a fresh sample (round 2). Both rounds were drawn from the one-page baselines (the short-card baselines came later) and judged under the rule of their time, which still counted title and heading lines. The rule was revised again (v3: title and heading lines are not claims) and checked on a fresh sample from the short-card baselines alone (shortCard), because the short cards are the comparison the public numbers use.

rounds.rule: supported if >= 50% of content words (4+ letters, not stopwords, 5-char prefix) occur in the story
